abilities.label: LOCATION
abilities.span: Your next Healing effect this turn deals damage instead.

dependencies.detail: what one 'Healing effect' is: every packet of one card's healing (Moonwell heals several characters) or one packet; whether Lifesteal counts
dependencies.source_needed: a log of a multi-target heal or Lifesteal right after the activation

dependencies.detail: R_AMOUNT_ORDER: the damage dealt is the healing amount after which bonuses and multipliers
dependencies.source_needed: a log with Cleansing Cleric's bonus or Atiesh active

decisions.question: Is one 'Healing effect' all heal packets of the next healing card, or one packet?
alternatives: all packets of the next healing effect
decisions.chosen: all packets of the next healing effect
decisions.discriminating_case: Moonwell after Ruby Sanctum: do all friendly characters take 4, or only the first

decisions.question: Does Lifesteal healing consume the effect?
decisions.discriminating_case: a Lifesteal attack after the activation: the own hero takes damage or heals

decisions.question: Is the effect kept when the activation spends the last Durability and the location leaves?
alternatives: kept: it is a player enchantment
decisions.chosen: kept: it is a player enchantment
decisions.discriminating_case: CONSEQUENCE-PILOT-1: last-charge activation still turned Flash Heal into damage; OBSERVATION-AUDIT-1: CATA_301e on the player entity with HEALING_DOES_DAMAGE
